input.body: We are writing to request a review of a $16.50 deduction on order DD-48267, dated 2026-11-07, which was applied with the reason "missing item" (Peanut Butter Bowl). The order ticket for DD-48267 lists the Peanut Butter Bowl, so the item was part of the order as it was prepared [DD-48267:ticket_lists_item]. The order was ready at 12:52 and was picked up at 12:55, three minutes later [DD-48267:pickup_handoff]. We have no further records of the bag contents at handoff, so we are stating only what the ticket and the pickup timestamps show. Based on these records, we respectfully ask that the deduction be reviewed and reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
